request: can you make me a tiny packing list? just passport, charger and toothbrush with a checkbox each, and a line saying how many of the three are packed. it should remember what i ticked so it's still there when i reload
design_rationale: A three-item checklist should be one narrow column: the heading, a bordered list with a checkbox per item that strikes the name through once packed, and the count underneath, neutral base on a single card.

verify.steps: Open the list and see Passport, Charger, Toothbrush and 0 of 3 packed, tick Passport and see 1 of 3 packed, tick Toothbrush and see 2 of 3 packed, reload and still see 2 of 3 packed.

why.services/packing.jac: PackItem node with a name and a packed flag; open_packing (a walker that creates the three items under root on first visit and reports them) and set_packed, which finds an item by id, sets its flag and returns it.
why.components/PackingList.jac: The whole screen: the Packing list heading, one checkbox row per item, the N of 3 packed line, loading and error text.
why.main.jac: Registers the packing endpoints, loads global.css and renders the list.

write_reasoning.services/packing.jac: Backend first: the list is read through a walker that seeds the items only when root has none, because a def:pub read is cached on the client. set_packed takes the item's jid, finds the node on the server and returns it so the client never reads the list again.
write_reasoning.components/PackingList.jac: The component spawns open_packing in async can with entry and awaits set_packed in an async handler. It replaces the ticked item in state with the returned node instead of refetching.
write_reasoning.main.jac: Last, main.jac: it imports services.packing with no leading dot so open_packing and set_packed are registered, and returns the list; one screen needs no router.

plan_call_reasoning: Plan the build: one screen with saved ticks, so a single component and a small server.
plan_reasoning: One screen: a Packing list heading, three fixed items with a checkbox each and an N of 3 packed line. The items are created on the server on first visit, read through a walker and ticked with a def:pub that returns the item. main.jac last.
plan_summary: Build plan written to .jaccoder/build_plan.json: a single-screen checklist, 3 files leaf-first, items on the server with a seeding walker and a set_packed def:pub, nova/neutral/amber/inter.
journal:
# Agent journal

## Issues
- A def:pub list is cached on the client on jac 0.34.28, so the items are read through the open_packing walker and each tick updates state from the item set_packed returns.

## Learnings
- open_packing creates Passport, Charger and Toothbrush only when root has no PackItem, so the first visit shows 0 of 3 packed.
- The client sends jid(item) and the new packed value; the server looks the node up by jid instead of mutating a node passed from the client.
- The packed count is a render local computed from the items in state.

## Last Action
Built Packing list: three checkbox rows and a packed count backed by a walker and one def:pub. The preview shows 0 of 3 packed, ticking Passport and Toothbrush gives 2 of 3 packed, and it stays after a reload.
final:
Packing list is running: tick an item and it is marked packed on the server, untick it to unmark it, and the count below says how many of the three are in. I ticked Passport and Toothbrush, saw 2 of 3 packed, and it was still 2 of 3 packed after a reload.

**Next steps**
- Add your own items to the list
- Clear all ticks for the next trip
- Group items by bag
